name: Er. Pradeep Kumar Singh
quote: Education is the Most Potent Weapon to Transform Sheohar
message: When we laid the foundation stone of Residential PDS Public School Sheohar, our vision was clear: to bring top-tier CBSE education right to the doorsteps of our children in Sheohar so they do not need to migrate to distant metropolitan cities. We have invested tirelessly in smart digital classrooms, experienced educators, and disciplined residential boarding to make this institution a beacon of hope, character building, and academic excellence in North Bihar.
shortBio: Pioneer in regional educational infrastructure and residential schooling in North Bihar.
fullBio: Er. Pradeep Kumar Singh spearheaded the establishment of Residential PDS Public School Sheohar with the mission of providing holistic, world-class school education in Sheohar district. Under his stewardship, the school has developed state-of-the-art physics, chemistry, biology, and computer laboratories, modern residential hostel wings with 24x7 guardianship, sports grounds, and competitive foundation batches for national exams.
experience: 16+ Years in Educational Administration & Institutional Leadership
responsibilities: Institutional governance, infrastructure planning, administrative oversight, and long-term vision.

name: Dr. S. K. Sharma
quote: Every Child is a Unique Seed with Limitless Potential
message: At Residential PDS Public School, we nurture not just academic aptitude, but character, resilience, and curiosity. Our faculty works hand-in-hand with parents to identify each student's strengths, whether in science, mathematics, literature, or athletic sports. I warmly welcome every parent to visit our campus and join our inspiring academic family.
shortBio: Distinguished academician with over 22 years of pedagogical leadership in reputed CBSE institutions.
fullBio: Dr. S. K. Sharma brings more than two decades of senior educational administration experience. He holds a doctorate in Educational Psychology and has guided numerous CBSE workshops on modern formative assessments, activity-based pedagogy, and student mental wellness. At PDS Public School, he oversees the day-to-day academic delivery, teacher training programs, and individual student progress monitoring.
experience: 22+ Years in Senior CBSE School Leadership & Teacher Mentorship
responsibilities: CBSE academic curriculum compliance, pedagogy, faculty development, and student counseling.

name: Prof. R. N. Choudhary
designation: Vice Principal & Head of Science Department
quote: Rigorous Concept Clarity with Continuous Mentorship
message: Our curriculum delivery focuses on deep conceptual understanding rather than rote memorization. We conduct regular remedial classes, interactive lab experiments, and weekly assessments to ensure no child is left behind in any academic discipline.
shortBio: Senior educator specializing in science pedagogy, laboratory sciences, and competitive foundation modules.
fullBio: Prof. R. N. Choudhary has dedicated 18 years to mentoring science students across secondary and senior secondary stages. He heads the practical laboratory program at Residential PDS Public School Sheohar, ensuring regular experimental exposure, science fairs, and analytical problem-solving sessions for board examinations.
experience: 18+ Years in Physics & Senior Secondary Science Pedagogy
responsibilities: Science laboratories, secondary examination coordination, and academic scheduling.
